# Review: plan:nav-home-prefetch

Head: dd9713a6e4adaad5b5ae748ab19adeaa8d1087dc. Parent:0cc3821b9c7bb3c6d88f78db2721a8efa27f6b85. Reviewer:pij-unaware-quokka.

## Verdict: BLOCK

Home/prefetch performance acceptance passes on the retained final build. Two consumer-visible metadata-cache correctness defects require correction. No product files changed by reviewer.

## MEDIUM / P2 — Missing/restored linked checkout never invalidates cached prunable state

**Location:** `packages/workflow/src/resolvers/git-worktree.resolver.ts:156–177`, especially168–174.

The stamp watches administrative HEAD/logs/HEAD/gitdir and linked-directory names, but not existence of the checkout targeted by gitdir. External deletion/rename leaves all watched metadata unchanged while `git worktree list` starts reporting isPrunable=true. The cached result remains false indefinitely; restoring the path has the reverse problem. `apps/web/app/(dashboard)/workspaces/[slug]/browser/page.tsx:59` filters !isBare&&!isPrunable, so the switcher continues offering a vanished checkout or hiding a restored one.

**Independent real-Git proof:** create main+linked checkout, warm retained compiled resolver using real UnixProcessManager/NodeFileSystemAdapter, rename linked directory without Git repair, call cached and uncached resolvers. Stamp unchanged; cached linked isPrunable=false, fresh linked isPrunable=true. No active repository was modified. Artifact `/tmp/reviewer-home-cache-results.json` contains exact paths/results; disposable repo removed afterward.

**Fix:** include checkout-target existence in metadata-only invalidation (resolve each administrative gitdir file); cover relevant locked/prunable state. Preserve zero unchanged-idle subprocesses rather than adding TTL polling. Keep regression coverage for disappearance and restoration.

## MEDIUM / P2 — Fulfilled Git failures become permanent empty discoveries

**Locations:** resolver115–142,145–147,206–219.

Eviction handles rejected list promises only. A failed availability probe resolves false and is memoized by supportedOnce forever; nonzero worktree-list exits resolve [] and are stored as successful cached results. Recovery of the executable or repository does not invalidate either outcome because the metadata stamp may be unchanged. A first transient spawn failure can therefore suppress every workspace for the server lifetime. UI displays no worktrees/loses branch search; repository-family consumers lose sibling scope.

**Independent real-Git proofs, same compiled code/adapters:**

| Failure then recovery | Cached after recovery | Fresh uncached |
|---|---:|---:|
| Hide git from PATH for first call, restore PATH |0worktrees|2worktrees|
| Temporarily malformed repository config makes worktree list exit nonzero, restore config |0worktrees|2worktrees|

The first demonstrates resolved-false support caching; the second demonstrates nonzero-list empty-result caching. Existing new cache test throws during list spawn and therefore does not cover either fulfilled failure. Artifact `/tmp/reviewer-home-cache-results.json`; fixture removed after proof.

**Fix:** remember successful availability/list results only. Distinguish an unavailable/failed version probe from a confirmed unsupported version; retry failed probes and do not cache their empty detection result. A normal valid empty result must remain distinct from command failure. Clearing just worktreeSupport is insufficient if same-stamp empty worktreeCache entries survive. No retry loop, fallback data or new idle Git polling is requested.

## Accepted implementation and limits

- Home server render reads registry list only, renders card grid immediately; worktree names/counts are post-load client enrichment, not true server Suspense streaming. The brief expressly permits cached API enrichment. Existing endpoint fetched twice by grid/sidebar; common singleton promise cache avoids duplicate Git; client-request dedupe remains item8/out of scope.
- Data-scaled links disable Next prefetch across cards, workspace nav/activity, unit lists/catalog, workspace table and worktree actions. Constant links remain prefetchable.
- Cache is one web-container resolver instance; CLI/workflow containers remain uncached. Singleflight get/set has no intervening await, and rejected-entry identity check prevents an older rejection deleting a newer entry. No mutation of returned arrays found in live consumers.
- Ordinary cache keys are registry roots; other arbitrary-path aliases exist in Pij scope, but no ordinary-consumer unbounded-growth defect was established. No generic memory-bound finding.
- Ref-only HEAD SHA can lag without logs/HEAD changes. API serializes head, but no current UI/workflow consumer reads Worktree.head; disclosed limitation, not an additional review blocker. Bare repos/no-readable-git-metadata stay uncached.
- The cache replaces a few-seconds proposal with stat/readdir-driven invalidation to meet zero unchanged-idle resolver launches. That choice is reasonable only if invalidation and failure recovery are correct as requested above.

## Independently exercised final-build proof

Retained author worktree `/Users/jordanknight/substrate/chainglass-home-prefetch`, HEADdd9713a6e, `.next/BUILD_ID=s0wIkmGHmwBUgTEhTHc9A`. No rebuild. Served Next on spare3103, nice19. Signed Auth.js session fixture plus bootstrap verification200; not native OAuth-login proof. All54workspace card links present in actual HTTP200 HTML and54cards hydrated.

| Scenario | Observed final result |

| Three home full-HTML responses |86.1ms,12.0ms,13.1ms;1-minload59.03;54cardlinks each |
| Home load +10s observation |3distinctprefetchroutepaths,6HTTPprefetchrequests; fixed/workspaces,/pij,/settings/workspaces only |
| Post-load branch search ten-tv |1/54; Cast AFL feat/ten-tv |

| Targeted changed suites |38tests passed in2files; resolver22/card16;5.34s |

HTTP figures are full-response times, not first-paint/hydration/cold-cache latency. First sample is first home request of this reviewer server session, not a fully cold OS/cache benchmark. Idle window saved exactt0/t1/head/build/loads/full Git lines in `/tmp/reviewer-home-idle-dd9713.json`. Other repos were actively changing; the2lists are compatible with invalidation but this proof did not snapshot their metadata at each timestamp, so not an independent causal attestation of real commits. No global all-Git-zero claim.

Inspected screenshots `/tmp/reviewer-home-dd9713.png` and `/tmp/reviewer-home-units-dd9713.png`. Console has no error entries; diagnostic log retains canceled RSC navigation requests (net::ERR_ABORTED), not falsely described as no network activity/errors. Standard Vitest does not provide browser evidence; these are actual browser observations.

## Authored baseline and idle-count correction

Exact historical baseline0aebeb1a5 scratch worktree removed; historical after runtime builds predate SSR/strip/rebase. Therefore old timings alone do not prove final composition; independent final measurements above close that gap for exercised paths. No valid same-session before browser-prefetch comparison exists because the baseline page rendered0links; PRD baseline is retained as historical evidence, not rerun here.

Raw logs/driver and summaries prove boot216→55 (list108→54,version108→1), no-client60s0→0, idle120s all-Git158→11: list70→3,version88→0,otherstatus/log/diff0→8. Original158→3“launches” mixed populations. Author published corrected deliverable63351d2ac plus notefb6c146bd; amendment read. Prime scope ruling192c explicitly accepts resolver-only list/version zero except real metadata invalidations; other8calls belong to trace-idle fix-c and are NOT a dd blocker. No-clientzero was already true at baseline. 3.6/s is arithmetic extrapolation, not observed heavy-load rate.

Next internals explain visible-link re-prefetch on router-tree/revalidating-action changes, but author did not reproduce the old idle repeated requests at the saturated baseline. Correctly say data-scaled amplification removed and final idle path passes; do not claim the old trigger was independently reproduced.

No hidden final-gate failure/worker/unhandled-error summary. Retained tracing/import.meta/deprecation/Reactact/color/watcher/expectednegative warnings are not warning-free output.

Build timestamp15:24:40 predates commit15:33:58. Author attests FFT ran the uncommitted final patch atop0cc, committed exact tree afterward with no edits; current retained HEAD matches. Log has no launch tree digest or BUILD_ID, so equivalence is supported author provenance, not cryptographic source-build attestation. No reviewer fullgate/build ran.

## Safe terminal proof and limit

This review created `/tmp/review-home-dd9713-tmux`, chmod700, before starting either process. Explicit `tmux -L default` resolution first named `/private/tmp/review-home-dd9713-tmux/tmux-501/default` (no server yet); after terminal creation an explicit `-S` display confirmed that socket and sessionchainglass-home-prefetch. This is actual private isolation, unlike earlier reviewer incidents. No default-server command or kill-server was used.

Sidecar4603 connected and localhost xterm typed/received computed HOME_REVIEW_42. Private explicit-S new-window command timed out; window/resize completion and LAN matrix are NOT proven. Reported to prime rather than claiming the full terminal gate. This diff changes DI registration but no instrumentation/auth/port/sidecar-startup files; whether a broader startup gate is required must not be silently represented as passed. No Jordan-server restart or main-tree build.

## Next

Author fixes both cache defects with behavioral regression coverage and supplies exact corrective SHA plus required full green gate/artifact provenance. Preserve the final build until reviewer release. Review does not authorize main edits, rebuilding Jordan's served output, touching default tmux, or deleting unrelated code. Publication remains exact-head BLOCK even though performance acceptance is independently green.
